title: 第127章 无量平安诀第126章 平安平平安安
slug: 不是吧这魔修过于正义
content_zh:
燕倾知道。
叶孤鸿这是又悟了。
他有些无奈，这叶孤鸿的脑补能力真是没谁了。
他的本意就是希望两人平平安安的，非要延伸那么远做什么？
不过，倒也不见得就是坏事。
不管叶孤鸿怎么脑补，只要结果是好的就行。
随后他打开了【系统商城】。
“系统，筛选功法。
要求：命硬、抗揍、保命能力天下第一，最好能让人一边挨打一边活蹦乱跳的那种。”
很快，系统面板上光芒一闪，一排排功法浮现出来。
燕倾的目光在一众花里胡哨的功法中快速扫过，最终停留在了一本散发着淡淡金光的古籍上。
看了眼价格，100万人气值！
不高也不低。
“兑换！”
【叮！
消耗100万人气值，成功兑换《无量平安诀》！
伴随着系统的清脆提示音，一股浩瀚古老的宏大气息，顺着燕倾的指尖悄然汇聚，最终化作了一枚温润如玉的玉简。
《无量平安诀》，听名字似乎平平无奇，但这可是系统出品的极品功法！
其真意在于“无量”
二字。

修炼至圆满，体内生机生生不息，肉身万劫不灭。
哪怕是天塌地陷、大道崩塌，亦能强行扭转因果，保自身一方绝对的“平安”
换句话说，这是一门将“防御”
与“生命力”
点到了极致的究极乌龟流功法！
燕倾指尖夹着这枚玉简，随手一抛。
“嗡——”
玉简瞬间悬停在两人面前，随即爆发出一阵柔和的金光，将两人笼罩，然后修炼法门就自动印入了他们的脑海。
“这门功法，名为《无量平安诀》。”
燕倾淡淡说道：“我不指望你们练了它能去毁天灭地、横推八荒。
但只要你们将此诀修至圆满，这世间能杀你们的人，便屈指可数。”
“轰！”
当听到“无量平安诀”
content_en:
Yan Qing knew.
Ye Guhong realized this again.
He was a little helpless. Ye Guhong's ability to think things through was really second to none.
His original intention was to hope that the two of them would be safe and sound, so why did he have to extend it so far?
However, it's not necessarily a bad thing.
No matter what Ye Guhong thinks, as long as the result is good.
Then he opened the [System Mall].
“System, screening techniques.
Requirements: The best in the world in terms of toughness, resistance to beatings, and life-saving ability. It is best to be able to make people jump around while being beaten. "
Soon, a light flashed on the system panel, and rows of techniques appeared.
Yan Qing's eyes quickly swept through the gaudy techniques, and finally landed on an ancient book that exuded a faint golden light.
After looking at the price, it’s worth 1 million votes!
Not high and not low.
"Exchange!"
[Ding!
Consume 1 million popularity points and successfully redeem the "Secret of Infinite Peace"!
Along with the system's crisp beep, a vast and ancient aura quietly gathered along Yan Qing's fingertips, and finally turned into a jade slip as warm as jade.
"Infinite Peace Technique" may sound like an ordinary technique from its name, but it is a top-notch technique produced by the system!
Its true meaning lies in "infinite"
Two words.
Once you practice to perfection, the vitality in your body will never end, and your physical body will be immortal for all eternity.
Even if the sky collapses, the earth collapses, and the road collapses, we can forcefully reverse the cause and effect and ensure absolute "peace" on our side.
In other words, this is a goalkeeper "defense"
and "vitality"
The Ultimate Oogway Flow Technique has been mastered to the extreme!
Yan Qing held the jade slip between her fingertips and tossed it away.
"Buzz——"
The jade slip instantly hovered in front of the two of them, and then burst out with a burst of soft golden light, covering the two of them, and then the cultivation method was automatically imprinted in their minds.
"This technique is called "The Secret of Infinite Peace"."
Yan Qing said calmly: "I don't expect you to practice it and destroy the world and destroy the world.
But as long as you practice this technique to perfection, there will be only a handful of people in this world who can kill you. "
"Boom!"
